spec_match.rationale: Climbs the spec's method steps in order — three RangeError argument checks before the InvalidStateError state check — and proves the ordering with the oversized-label-on-failed-session case; the ceiling (≥4096, Chromium 4096) matches the implementation.

interactive.rationale: One button opens a real session attempt, waits for its ready to reject, then runs six real exportKeyingMaterial calls and tabulates each exception.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises every rung plus the ordering proof; the table has exactly those rows.

edge_cases.rationale: This is the edge concept: it handles no-WebTransport, method-absent (pre-158), and each rejection rung, with the ordering case as the headline.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4860330806214656 and the method steps; the feature index adds RFC 5705 and RFC 8446 §7.5.

conformance.rationale: New 7-assertion suite encodes the method presence, arity, the three RangeError rungs with ordering, the failed-session InvalidStateError and NewObject; honest fails on this pre-158 container.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): run clicked; the ready-rejection row confirmed the failed state, and the method-absent row honestly reported exportKeyingMaterial missing from the prototype with the rungs correctly not probed; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the five rejection rungs need a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover the method-missing branch and, on a supporting build, the ladder ordering and row count; all exports are awaited with caught rejections.

design_system.rationale: ok/err cell inks on bg-paper at AA, paired with full exception text.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, caption + scoped-header table in an overflow wrapper, verdict is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Observe the five rejection rungs on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: On a 158+ build, verify the three RangeError rungs fire on a failed session (proving validation precedes the state check) and the valid-argument call reaches InvalidStateError, with the conformance suite at 7/7.

guidanceConsulted.query: TLS exporter keying material validation errors
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Demonstrate cryptographic API validation with real calls and exact error types rather than described behavior.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every rung is a real exportKeyingMaterial call whose actual exception name and message are tabulated; no rejection is predicted.

guidanceConsulted.query: error ladder table accessible not color only
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair color-coded pass/fail with the literal exception text and use scoped table headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each cell prints the exception name/message alongside its color; the table has caption + th scope.

summary: Validation ladder in spec order with the ordering proof (RangeError before InvalidStateError on a failed session). Driven on headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): real failed session, honest method-absent reporting, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
